summary: YNAB needs a first-class read-only finance snapshot workflow that separates operating cash from asset-like accounts and summarizes recent category burn.
reason: The generated endpoint wrappers expose raw YNAB data, but purchase/runway decisions require YNAB-specific aggregation across accounts and month categories; compact output also collapses YNAB's nested response envelope too aggressively for this use case.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; workflow finance-snapshot --months 4 --manual-isa 18044.27 --manual-btc 0.467 --json returned operating_cash 22037.89 and March-May/June category burn from the live YNAB API.
